chunks: He said: Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Qulawayh, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me, saying: My father narrated to me, from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab together, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon them both) who said:

Musa son of Imran, may blessings be upon our Prophet, his family, and upon him, said: "O my God! Who are Your chosen ones from among Your creation?" He said: "The one with generous palms, the one with bountiful feet, who speaks truthfully and walks with humility. Those are such that the mountains may move, but they would not."

He said: "O my God! Then who will dwell in the abode of holiness with You?" He said: "Those whose eyes do not gaze upon this world, and they do not divulge their secrets in religion, and they do not accept bribes for authority. Truth is in their hearts, and truthfulness is on their tongues. Those are under My protection in this world and in the abode of holiness with Me in the hereafter."

key_terms.الري الكفين: Generous of palms; a metaphor for boundless charity

ai.seo_question: What are the qualities of Allah's chosen servants according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Amali of al-Mufid, Imam al-Baqir (AS) relates a dialogue between Prophet Musa (Moses) and Allah. When Musa asks who God's chosen servants are, Allah describes them as generous, truthful, and humble -- steadfast as mountains. When asked about the inhabitants of the holy abode, Allah describes them as detached from worldly desires, guarding religious secrets, refusing bribes, carrying truth in their hearts and on their tongues. This narrative genre, where Prophets converse with God, was a valued teaching tool in early Shia scholarly circles for conveying ethical ideals.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abul Qasim Ja’far ibn Muhammad ibn Qawlawayh - may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from his father, from Sa’d ibn Abdillah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa and Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abul Khattab together, from al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, from Ibn Sinan, from Abu Hamzah al-Thumali, that: Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn ‘Ali al-Baqir, peace be upon him, said:

Musa son of Imran, may Allah bless our Prophet (and his progeny) and him, said: "O Allah! Who are the sincere, pure servants of Yours among Your creation?" He said: "One with the generous palms and the bountiful feet. He speaks truthfully, and walks modestly. They are such that the mountains may move, but they would not."

He said: "O Allah! Who are the ones who will land in the sacred abode at yours?" He (Allah) said: "They are the ones whose eyes do not look (at all) at the world and they do not let out their secrets in faith and they accept no bribe to attain the authority. Certitude is in their hearts and truth is on their tongues. They are under My shield in this world and in the sacred abode hereafter, they will be with Me."
